tagline: Old money meets new energy — one of Istanbul's most affluent and leafy addresses, with excellent dining and a sophisticated local crowd.

items.name: Akmerkez AVM Cafés
items.description: The upscale Akmerkez shopping centre has multiple good café options. A reliable stop in the area.

items.name: Ulus Parkı Çay Bahçesi
items.description: A beautiful tea garden in Ulus Park with panoramic views of the Bosphorus. One of Istanbul's most scenic spots for a slow morning.
items.tip: Go on a clear weekday morning. The Bosphorus view from the park terrace is spectacular.

items.name: Nişantaşı Sokak Restoranları
items.description: The streets of Etiler have a cluster of upscale restaurants catering to wealthy Istanbul residents. Quality is consistently high.

items.name: Ulus 29 Restaurant
items.description: A legendary Istanbul restaurant set in a villa above the Bosphorus with stunning views. One of the city's most spectacular dining settings.
items.tip: Book well ahead — this is one of Istanbul's most in-demand tables. Go for a special occasion.

items.name: Ulus Parkı
items.description: A beautiful hilltop park with sweeping Bosphorus views. Popular with dog walkers and joggers in the morning. Very upscale, very calm.

items.name: Akmerkez Shopping
items.description: One of Istanbul's original luxury malls — still a reliable destination for premium brands and good food options.

tips: Etiler is best reached by taxi from Levent (M2 metro). No direct metro access.
One of Istanbul's wealthiest residential areas — prices for food and services reflect this.
The Ulus area (above Etiler) is even more exclusive, with some of the city's finest villas and Bosphorus-view restaurants.
Bebek is a pleasant downhill walk from Etiler — combine both in an afternoon.
